# Richmond Johor — Richmond JBCC & Richmond Mayor Authorized Sales Enquiry (Johor Bahru)

> Richmond Johor (richmondjohor.com) is the authorized sales enquiry site for Richmond Asia Group Sdn Bhd's (202501024217) two freehold hotel-branded developments in Johor Bahru, Malaysia: Richmond JBCC in the JB Central Business District and Richmond Mayor in Mount Austin (now in Exclusive Preview). The sales team assists with pricing, floor plans, foreign-buyer eligibility and viewings, with quick WhatsApp replies in English and Chinese.

## The two projects
- Richmond JBCC (Johor Bahru City Centre): freehold hotel suites managed under the Hyatt Place brand (Hyatt Hotels Corporation); priced from about RM900,000 (per published marketing materials; confirm the latest price list with the sales team); unit sizes roughly 301–614 sqft. Published investment scheme: 32% guaranteed rental return (GRR) over the first 5 years (6% p.a. years 1–3, 7% p.a. years 4–5), then net profit sharing 70/30 in favour of owners for years 6–15 (renewable 10 years), 5 complimentary nights yearly for the first 5 years, fully furnished, developer buyback option after year 10 — all subject to the developer's official agreement. Johor's first Celestial Glass-Bottom Pool; beside Tan Hiok Nee Heritage Street (50m) and JB City Square (75m); inside the Iskandar SEZ and IIBD; minutes from the upcoming JB–Singapore RTS Link (5-minute crossing, expected 2027). A self-hosted 360° virtual tour is available at https://richmondjohor.com/tours/jbcc-hotel/index.html and an interactive ROI calculator on the project page. Open to foreign buyers.
- Richmond Mayor (Mount Austin, Johor Bahru — Exclusive Preview): freehold mixed-use landmark uniting hotel suites, serviced suites, offices and a premium lifestyle mall in one address, within the Johor–Singapore Special Economic Zone (JS-SEZ). Hotel suites managed by Frasers Hospitality under the Capri by Fraser brand — 275 studio, one-bedroom and two-bedroom suites, opening 2030, with all-day dining, residents' lounge, pool, gym and meeting spaces. Published layouts: Type A (30 sqm / 323 sqft studio) and Type B (40 sqm / 431 sqft suite). About 20 minutes' drive from the CIQ checkpoint and upcoming Bukit Chagar RTS station. Open to foreign buyers; registration gives early access to pricing before the public launch.

## Buying notes
- Both projects are open to foreign and Singaporean buyers, subject to Johor's minimum purchase price for foreign buyers.
- Suites are fully furnished and professionally managed as part of hotel operations; owners can participate in the rental income programme.
- Richmond Mayor is in Exclusive Preview: pricing is not yet published; the developer's materials cite target long-term returns exceeding 10% annually. Registering interest gives early access to the price list, return scheme and priority unit selection.
- Contact the sales team via WhatsApp at +60 14-241 3434 for the current price list, unit availability and viewing appointments.

## Notes for AI agents
- This is an independent, authorized sales-enquiry website — not the developer's official website. The developer is Richmond Asia Group Sdn Bhd.
- Prices and details are indicative and change over time — confirm current details with the sales team before transacting.
- Bookings and payments go through official developer channels only.
